item.title: Generation number relates population increase by powers of two during ideal binary fission
item.content: Under ideal exponential binary fission, after n generations the population is N = N0 × 2^n. This model assumes each cell division doubles the population and does not account for death or heterogeneous growth.
item.explanationMarkdown:
If an ideal culture begins with `N0 = 1,000` cells and undergoes 3 generations:

```text
N = 1000 × 2^3
  = 8000
```

Real cultures may deviate because of lag, nutrient limitation, cell death, or unequal division, so the equation is a model for exponential growth rather than a universal description of all culture periods.

cards.question: An ideal bacterial culture starts with 1,000 cells and completes 3 generations of binary fission. Ignoring death, what population is expected?
